Delicious lunch
Aug 2025 • Solo
Went to this restaurant for lunch because I was nearby. The place looks very decent: two floors, there are tables outside. Inside is a stylish and beautiful interior, the atmosphere is calm and disposing.
The menu is presented in fusion format, above average prices. The staff is friendly, the service is good. The nice thing is there are bottles of water on the tables. I ordered salmon bruschetta and shrimp pasta. The order came in pretty quickly. The serving is beautiful, the dishes look delicious, the dishes are tasteful. The portions are more restaurant-like - small. It tasted good. Later, I'd come back here again and order a tuna salad. He was pleasantly surprised - there was a full tuna steak with a beautiful serving, which made the dish particularly successful. Overall the place left a positive impression: good interior, pleasant atmosphere and decent kitchen. Great for a quiet lunch or dinner.

Wish We’d Found This Sooner!
Feb 2026 • Couples
We came to this café towards the end of our stay and ended up coming back two nights in a row for dinner — which says it all really. I only wish we had discovered it earlier.

It somehow manages to feel both casual and classy at the same time. The atmosphere is relaxed but thoughtfully styled, making it a lovely place to unwind in the evening.

The staff were wonderful — friendly, welcoming, and spoke great English, which made everything easy and comfortable. We loved our meals so much the first night that we ordered exactly the same dishes again the second night — no regrets!

Even the bathrooms were spotless and beautifully styled, matching the overall ambience of the restaurant, which is always a good sign.

If we come to Nha trang again we will definitely try breakfast and coffee too. Highly recommend.
